question: It is an intermediate in the synthesis of cholesterol:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Acetyl-CoA -> HMG-CoA -> 3-Hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA -> 90% CHAIN: Acetyl-CoA -> HMG-CoA -> Mevalonate -> Cholesterol -> 80% CHAIN: Acetyl-CoA -> HMG-CoA -> Farnesyl pyrophosphate -> Squalene -> Cholesterol -> 90%
analysis: 3-Hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA is an intermediate in the synthesis of cholesterol, specifically in the mevalonate pathway.
